Please investigate why the KNIRVSERVER's instance of the knirvhasher pipeline still stalls at the data-encoder stage. The most recent fix was recently applied:
The encoder fix: AutoDetectInputFile was hardcoded to search ~/.local/share/hasher/data/json/ but the data-miner writes to the KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR path (/var/lib/knirvserver/hasher/data/json/ when running under the server). The encoder was finding an old stale file from February instead of the fresh GOAT dataset output. Now it searches the app data directory first (where data-miner actually writes), with the home directory path as a fallback.

Please audit the headless knirvhasher pipeline to ensure the data moves smoothly across all relevant programs in the pipeline. Note: The data-connector might be being skipped when the KNIRVSERVER launches the knirvhasher when I click the "Train" button in the Neural Desktop, but the data-connector is the phase that holds the knirvbase (database with live arrow servive down the pipeline), so we might need to instantiate the data-connector for the database, then make the data-miner use that database instance and have it seen by the data-encoder and data-trainer later in the pipeline as intended via the arrow stream as intended primarily, falling back to the simultaneously written json filea as needed.
